bio: Drawing on their experience at renowned restaurants and hotels, Veronika and Uwe Machreich run this idyllic establishment in a quiet, rural village setting. They have a lovingly tended garden that provides herbs and vegetables for the kitchen. The cuisine strikes a good balance between traditional and innovative elements. A shorter version of the evening menu is available at lunchtime – it features modern dishes with a twist, such as Waldviertel organic chicken, pepper and corn pancake and pimientos de Padrón. At lunchtime, delicious options on the Wirtshauskarte menu include Kalbsrahmbeuschl (veal lights ragout) or Zwiebelrostbraten (fried beef and onions in gravy). Or why not take a punt on the surprise menu? There is also a small farm shop selling delicatessen and house-made items. Over...
